facts.statement: Eostriatolamia is an extinct genus of sharks belonging to the family Odontaspididae.
facts.quote: Eostriatolamia is an extinct genus of sharks in the family Odontaspididae.

facts.statement: The genus Eostriatolamia was first described by Gluckman in 1980.
facts.quote: It was described by Gluckman in 1980.

facts.statement: The species Eostriatolamia paucicorrugata was described in 2010 by Underwood and Cumbaa from Cenomanian rocks in Canada.
facts.quote: A new species, E. paucicorrugata, was described from the Cenomanian of Canada by Charlie J. Underwood and Stephen L. Cumbaa in 2010.

facts.statement: Eostriatolamia is classified within the class Chondrichthyes.
Eostriatolamia lived from the Tithonian to the Maastrichtian stages, between 149.2 and 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Tithonian to Maastrichtian (149.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are 88 recorded fossil occurrences of Eostriatolamia in the Paleobiology Database.
